notes.title: Skillwood v0.22.5 - prestige upgrades hotfix
notes.notes:
I could've done it earlier, but I'm a little bit low on motivation lately. Hope I can keep going with ~monthly updates as usual.

Changelog:
- Maxing out AOE blast skill damage multiplier won't make it deal 0 damage anymore. Thanks to @bz-mof, @Xen, @Lamey the Clown and @Blue64 for letting me know about the issue
- Changed UI behaviour of prestige upgrades, now they don't hide upgrade value on max out and only hide next level souls requirements (since you can't upgrade it any further)
- Fixed next level upgrade cost in portal confirmation dialog. It crashed the game in dev mode and could've bring some problems into production build too.


Thanks everyone. I hope I can write a post in discussions about further plans on the game. As you might've noticed, the game is a little experiment - incremental game under the sauce of survival/farming game. And this "sauce" shot me in the knee, since it brought the expectations for survival/farming scope game, that I didn't planned to do. There won't be enemies, farming, cooking and so on. I want to keep making it as a basic incremental game with a relaxing wibe, nothing too overwhelming. I know it won't be enough for some players, but I hope there will be still people who can enjoy it.

notes.title: Skillwood - Early access release - v0.22.0
notes.notes:
Skillwood finally enters Early Access. I think I kept it in demo for too long already, since I see there's enough content to play for an early access version. I supported demo version since january and you helped me a lot with giving feedback, which I used to improve the game. In this perspective nothing will change. Game is still free, I will still listen to your feedback and try to reply in discussions. 
The only new thing in this perspective - is the discord account of the game. I'm keeping track of my plans, send there future features and track bugs too. I still have my vision, so sometimes we can have different opinions on where the game should go, but I'll still try to listen to feedback and look behind the words of what flaw of the game might make one want something.

And here goes the traditional part.

Changelog

Character selection

Now you can pick one of two default characters to play for. Right now there are only two, but there's a good fundament for further extension. Also, you might notice I did the second character sprite much later as it has little things like hair movement. Hope you like it too

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/343a094a7455cc652e355d652e49e0c505e87cb6.gif


Steam achievements

There are currently 11 achievements in the game which can be achieved pretty quickly. So I guess it's easy gold in 40 minutes or so. But I plan to extend the list in future, so I hope you won't be too frustrated if the "gold" will be taken away at some point. However current one are so basic and logical I don't think I will change them. Maximum - rename or change their sprites.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/a1ec9c1fcca30c1302444b5da2f20b225ab613f8.png


Prestige UI updates

These updates are based on feedback in steam discussions and in discord. The main updates are:

 Now in prestige confirm dialog you can see informations how many upgrades you can buy if you always buy the cheapest one and how many more souls you need to earn to buy one more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/bc4a0d4071f8cc32009f03b3b7ca56d20603caf8.png

 Before exiting prestige world back to the main one there's a confirm dialog too. And it shows you how many more upgrades you can buy right now in case you forgot to.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/205ea4fc8fd65cc2f759be97091c16ce4b9d7ed9.png



Music and sounds

I tried to make main menu more alive, so I created simple background music for it and also created sound effects for ui elements like buttons and sliders. I recieved feedback about silent menu multiple times so the main menu background music was in the wait list for too long already.
No screenshot's here cause it's, you know, sounds.


Other updates and fixes

 Rebalanced first forest: made second level upgrades cheaper and added more berry bushes. Game ended up being grindy so I tried to at least minimize it in the first upgradable area.
 Rebalanced sticks to logs barter. Now you need less sticks for the first NPC. You didn't have too much stick source anyway, so this barter became very stick bushes dependant, which I tried to manage somehow
 Added new sticky bushes to starter area. For the same reason as written above. The update is not so big, but it almost double the amount of sticky bushes, so it should make sticks to logs trade even easier
 Fixed this bug of game crashing sometimes when you prestige. It was quite a journey to find it. Hope I succeeded 
 Save player world wherever you are in prestige world or in main world. So when you exited game while presting and load it afterwards you end up in the prestige world, so you can buy all the upgrades and don't wait for the next prestige.




Thank everyone for the support up to this moment. I hope you will enjoy the early access version too. And please, don't forget about the discord to stay in tune with the upcoming plans.
Discord: https://discord.gg/MX8Gagsws7

notes.title: Demo v0.20.4 - small hotfix of bugs with default volume and souls tutorial
notes.notes:
Demo v0.20.4

The story repeats and a new video revealed new bugs. These bugs got me in a middle of working on big update, so I hidden the feature I was working at and quickly fixed these issues. Muted sounds by default can really spoil the impression of the game even though there's a settings window for this.

Changelog

 Changed value of default volume from 0, so the game won't be muted by default anymore (the most important thing)
 Fixed sprites of a portal in souls tutorial panels that became broken after portal animations update


That video

[previewyoutube=0vllgbZHzR4;full][/previewyoutube]

As I wrote in the comment to that video I'm happy that most of the problems that was mentioned there COULD be compensated with the updated I'm working with because of things will be unlocked earlier.

notes.title: Demo v0.20.2 - souls shop hotfix
notes.notes:
Problem: since I make covers for new versions in game itself, I, as usual, did it with v0.20.0. However because I did it with souls shop scene instead of main menu scene as usual, I forgot to remove it before building new 0.20.1 version. So souls shop ended up being almost unusable. Player is hidden (but still controllable) and view is covered with version info panels, making this shop almost unusable. 

That's litterally how it looked IN GAME:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832356/6650c18a80ff9440736054d156d4da6c490d0fce.png

Thanks A LOT to QuanticFlux for letting me know even before he uploaded the video as I uploaded hotfix 0.20.2 version 36 hours ago. So
The good thing - the bugged version was in steam for around 12 hours
The bad thing - new video will be with this bugged version, so if you want to check how stupid was the mistake I made you can check it out on QuanticFlux channel. Thanks again to him

So the biggest think I can do to thank him is to ask you (2-3 people that will read this changelog) to check out his channel.
https://www.youtube.com/@QuanticFlux
